# Techniques

Synthetic test data. Format:
`- <technique> | aliases: <a>; <b> | level: hands-on|familiar | years_ok: yes|no | evidence: L-0012, L-0031`

- real-time PCR | aliases: qPCR; quantitative PCR | level: hands-on | years_ok: yes | evidence: L-0004, L-0010, L-0014
- environmental monitoring | aliases: EM program | level: hands-on | years_ok: yes | evidence: L-0001, L-0003
- endotoxin testing | aliases: LAL testing; bacterial endotoxin testing | level: hands-on | years_ok: no | evidence: L-0005
- 16S rRNA sequencing | aliases: 16S sequencing; amplicon sequencing | level: hands-on | years_ok: yes | evidence: L-0011
- ELISA | aliases: enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay | level: hands-on | years_ok: no | evidence: L-0017
- anaerobic culture | aliases: anaerobe culture | level: hands-on | years_ok: yes | evidence: L-0010, L-0012
- MALDI-TOF identification | aliases: MALDI-TOF | level: hands-on | years_ok: no | evidence: L-0007
- confocal microscopy | aliases: confocal imaging | level: familiar | years_ok: no | evidence: L-0016
- sterility testing | aliases: sterility test | level: hands-on | years_ok: no | evidence: L-0008
- bioburden testing | aliases: bioburden | level: hands-on | years_ok: no | evidence: L-0008
